name: 15143 · Sewickley, PA
findings: ZIP 15143 (Sewickley) has 155 nonprofit organizations. 77 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15143 (Sewickley) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
